story: University of Alaska regents postpone the vote on AI Engaged, the system AI statement of intent whose first draft was generated with Anthropic's Claude, to February

per_url.result: ok; no link to the AI Engaged document or a board packet, only https://www.alaska.edu/bor/agendas/ (not fetched)
ok, tool paraphrased most of it

claims.claim: The University of Alaska Board of Regents postponed its vote on AI Engaged until its February meeting to allow more time for input.
claims.verbatim: Regents postponed voting on AI Engaged until their February meeting to allow more time for input.
claims.notes: Corroborated independently by KTUU (C29): 'pushes off the final decision on the university system's AI intent language until February'. The BOR site (primary summary of actions) returned 503, so no primary record of the action was reachable.

claims.claim: KTUU reported the decision was pushed to February or until requested by UA President Matt Cooper.
claims.verbatim: pushes off the final decision on the university system's AI intent language until February ... requested by UA President Matt Cooper
claims.notes: Fetch tool returned the two fragments separately; joining wording ('or until') is reconstructed, so phrase as 'or earlier at Cooper's request, according to KTUU'. needs_softening true. Page timestamp Nov. 9, 2026 at 10:03 PM AKST despite the 11/10 URL.

claims.claim: Regents directed the AI Coordinating Council to begin crafting campus-specific AI policies in the interim.
claims.verbatim: Regents also directed the AI Coordinating Council to begin crafting campus-specific AI policies in the interim.
claims.notes: Single secondary source; KTUU does not mention it. Attribute to ADN.

claims.claim: Both the UA Board of Regents and the UAA Faculty Senate postponed votes on AI-related measures.
claims.verbatim: both the UA Board of Regents and University of Alaska Anchorage Faculty Senate postponed votes on AI-related measures.

claims.claim: UAA Faculty Senate members postponed voting on a resolution rejecting and replacing AI Engaged until next month.
claims.verbatim: Faculty Senate members at UAA also postponed voting on a resolution rejecting and replacing AI Engaged until next month.
claims.notes: 'Next month' is relative to a November 12th article, i.e. December; say 'until December, according to ADN' only with that hedge.

claims.claim: UA chief information technology officer Ben Shier created the initial AI Engaged draft by prompting Claude with human ideas about appropriate AI use.
claims.verbatim: created the initial AI Engaged draft by prompting Claude with human ideas about appropriate AI use.
claims.notes: Corroborated in substance by the Hartley and Potter op-ed (C32). ADN does not name Anthropic in the fetched passage; the op-ed does ('Anthropic's Claude').

claims.claim: Shier described the human inputs as all fed to Claude.
claims.verbatim: all fed to Claude.
claims.notes: Fragment quote only; the fetch tool did not return the full surrounding sentence. Use only as the four-word fragment.

claims.claim: Regents directed Shier in May to begin preparing the document.
claims.verbatim: Shier was directed to begin preparing the document by regents in May.
claims.notes: Consistent with the UA release (C26), which says the Board asked leadership in May to develop a cohesive strategy.

claims.claim: Shier said only about 20 percent of the initial AI Engaged draft survived several rounds of human edits.
claims.verbatim: only about 20% of the initial two-page AI Engaged draft survived several rounds of edits from humans
claims.notes: Shier's own estimate; attribute ('Shier said'). needs_softening true. The ADN tool output says the edits happened over the summer but returned that part as paraphrase; do not quote 'summer' as Shier's word.

claims.claim: The initial AI Engaged draft was two pages long.
claims.verbatim: only about 20% of the initial two-page AI Engaged draft survived several rounds of edits from humans
claims.notes: Compare C13: the current document is four pages.

claims.claim: After prompting Claude, Shier shared the result with select faculty and students days later.
claims.verbatim: After prompting Claude, Shier said he shared the result with select faculty and students days later.
claims.notes: Shier's account; attribute.

claims.claim: The human edits to the draft took place over the summer, according to ADN's account of Shier's remarks.
claims.verbatim: the edits happened over the summer
claims.notes: Fetch tool PARAPHRASED this; verbatim field is the tool's wording, not confirmed page text. Corroborated in substance by ADN October 4th (C38 notes): 'Shier drafted the AI intent language over the summer at the request of regents.' Prefer that verbatim if used.

claims.claim: AI Engaged is a four-page document establishing principles for AI use across UA campuses.
claims.verbatim: four-page document establishing principles for AI use across UA campuses.
claims.notes: Page count NOT verified against the document itself; the UA release does not link the document and the BOR site returned 503. Attribute to ADN.

claims.claim: AI Engaged does not establish policy but requires system-wide coordination on AI.
claims.verbatim: does not establish policy but requires system-wide coordination on AI.
claims.notes: Corroborated by KTUU (C31): 'designed not to act as policy'.

claims.claim: AI Engaged requires a report to regents on a system-wide AI policy within one year of its adoption.
claims.verbatim: report to regents on a system-wide AI policy within one year of its adoption.

claims.claim: AI Engaged requires each of the three universities to create its own policy governing AI use.
claims.verbatim: requires each of the three universities to create their own policy governing AI use.
claims.notes: ADN does not name the three. The UA release names UAA, UAF and UAS (C25). KTOO September 16th described an earlier draft the same way (C39).

claims.claim: A petition from nearly 200 students and staff, mostly in Anchorage, asked regents to adopt a brief statement written by humans.
claims.verbatim: A group of nearly 200 students and staff ... mostly in Anchorage ... adopt a brief statement written by humans.
claims.notes: Fetch tool returned three separate fragments; ellipses mark joins. The word 'petition' is from the scout brief and the tool's framing, not confirmed verbatim; safer copy is 'a group of nearly 200 students and staff'. needs_softening true.

claims.claim: UA President Matthew Cooper said the university is never going to have everyone on the same page with AI.
claims.value: never going to have everyone on the same page
claims.verbatim: It's a situation where we're never going to have everyone on the same page with AI.
claims.notes: ADN renders his name Matthew Cooper; KTUU uses Matt Cooper.

claims.claim: Cooper said the system had heard many concerns but also real strong support for moving with urgency.
claims.verbatim: While we have heard many concerns, we also have heard real strong support for moving, and moving with urgency,
claims.notes: Quote verified. The fetched output did NOT confirm that it was said at the regents meeting; do not add 'at the meeting' unless hedged ('Cooper said').

claims.claim: UAA Faculty Senate chair Andrea Dewees said the process is probably going to be messy.
claims.verbatim: I think it's probably going to be messy.
claims.notes: Context of 'it' (what will be messy) not returned by the tool; quote it bare.

claims.claim: Shier said AI Engaged does not bind the institutions long term to any direction.
claims.verbatim: It does not bind the institutions long term to any direction.

claims.claim: The Board of Regents met in Fairbanks on the UAF campus from November 4th to 6th.
claims.verbatim: in Fairbanks, November 4-6, on the University of Alaska Fairbanks (UAF) campus
claims.source_outlet: University of Alaska System (release via EIN Presswire)
claims.notes: UA's own release dated Tuesday, November 3, 2026; posted on EIN Presswire November 04, 2026 02:57 GMT. KTUU November 6th corroborates Fairbanks, Butrovich Building, Wednesday through Friday.

claims.claim: Ben Shier was scheduled to share the latest version of the AI Engaged effort at the November meeting.
claims.verbatim: will share the latest version of UA's 'AI Engaged' effort.
claims.source_outlet: University of Alaska System (release via EIN Presswire)
claims.notes: Release uses single quotes around AI Engaged as rendered by the tool.

claims.claim: UA says the statement establishes six guiding principles, four investment priorities and five system-wide expectations.
claims.verbatim: The statement establishes six guiding principles, four investment priorities and five system-wide expectations
claims.source_outlet: University of Alaska System (release via EIN Presswire)
claims.notes: Also anchors 'four investment priorities' and 'five system-wide expectations'. Describes the version presented in November; the document itself was not reachable.

claims.claim: UA says AI Engaged preserves UAA, UAF and UAS responsibility for curriculum, academic integrity and faculty instructional judgment.
claims.verbatim: preserving UAA, UAF and UAS responsibility ... curriculum, academic integrity and faculty instructional judgment.
claims.source_outlet: University of Alaska System (release via EIN Presswire)
claims.notes: Two fragments joined by the tool; ellipsis marks the join.

claims.claim: In May the Board asked UA leadership to develop a cohesive strategy around the university's approach to AI.
claims.verbatim: develop a cohesive strategy around the university's approach
claims.source_outlet: University of Alaska System (release via EIN Presswire)
claims.notes: The 'In May' framing was returned as tool paraphrase around the quoted fragment; consistent with ADN (C08).

claims.claim: UA says the final document incorporates feedback from students, faculty and staff across the system.
claims.value: feedback from students, faculty and staff
claims.verbatim: The final document incorporates feedback from students, faculty and staff across the system,
claims.source_outlet: University of Alaska System (release via EIN Presswire)
claims.notes: Institutional self-description, one-sided; frame as 'UA says'. needs_softening true.

claims.claim: Cooper said in the UA release that student learning remains at the heart of the university's mission.
claims.value: student learning remains at the heart
claims.verbatim: student learning remains at the heart of our mission.
claims.source_outlet: University of Alaska System (release via EIN Presswire)
claims.notes: Fragment of a longer Cooper quote.

claims.claim: KTUU reported the delay gives the information technology department time to incorporate feedback from faculty, staff and students.
claims.verbatim: giving the information technology department time to incorporate feedback from faculty, staff and students into the document
claims.notes: Independent corroboration of C01.

claims.claim: KTUU reported the delay was recommended by Shier.
claims.verbatim: The action was recommended by Chief Technology Officer Benjamin Shier
claims.notes: KTUU title 'Chief Technology Officer'; ADN and UA use 'chief information technology officer'. Use the UA title.

claims.claim: KTUU reported the document is designed not to act as policy but to outline the approach UA is taking toward AI.
claims.verbatim: designed not to act as policy, but simply to outline the approach the UA institution is taking toward AI.
claims.notes: Corroborates C14.

claims.claim: UAA associate professors Gregory Hartley and Joel Potter wrote that Anthropic's Claude generated the initial draft and that this was concealed until October 9th.
claims.verbatim: Anthropic's Claude generated the initial draft, a fact concealed for months until Oct. 9.
claims.source_outlet: Anchorage Daily News (opinion, Gregory Hartley and Joel Potter)
claims.notes: OPINION. 'Concealed' is the authors' characterization; needs_softening true, write 'first disclosed October 9th, the authors say'. Page date shown as November 4, 2026 though the URL path is 11/03.

claims.claim: Hartley and Potter wrote that the Board of Regents should abandon the document and go back to the drawing board.
claims.verbatim: The UA Board of Regents should abandon the document and go back to the drawing board,
claims.source_outlet: Anchorage Daily News (opinion, Gregory Hartley and Joel Potter)
claims.notes: Opinion; attribute.

claims.source_outlet: Anchorage Daily News (opinion, Jennifer Carroll, Jackie Cason, James Ryan, Andrew Harnish, Erin Trochim)
